name: Joel
lede: The twenty-ninth book of the Bible, in full: the palmer-worm, the locust, the canker-worm and the caterpillar; blow ye the trumpet in Zion, for the day of Jehovah cometh; rend your heart, and not your garments; I will pour out my Spirit upon all flesh; and multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Day of Jehovah
books.blurb: The word of Jehovah to Joel: that which the palmer-worm hath left hath the locust eaten; the vine laid waste and the priests mourning; blow ye the trumpet in Zion — a day of darkness and gloominess, a great people and a strong; yet even now, rend your heart, and not your garments; I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten; I will pour out my Spirit upon all flesh; beat your plowshares into swords; multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision; and the mountains shall drop down sweet wine.
